deviations.claim_in_article: It looked like a very large fee would appear every time a ship passed through the strait.
deviations.issue: The proposal is framed as a fee assessed per ship passage, whereas the Ledger specifies a 20% rate on all cargo and does not specify a per-vessel charge or its calculation method.
deviations.explanation: The per-ship-passage charging basis is not established by the Ledger, changing the proposal’s scope and adding a specific unsupported claim (changed_fact, changed_scope, unsupported_new_claim). The nearby caveat says collection had not begun, but does not establish that charging basis.
deviations.qualifier_text: “It looked like”; “The fee was not actually being collected yet. It was still only at the stage of announcing the policy.”
